quote_data.pmpStrategy:
Executive Overview:
End-to-end multi-crew media coverage and creative production strategy for the grand launch of D9 Dehradun. Designed to capture high-energy event highlights, luxury ambiance, and cinematic spatial perspectives to drive immediate social media virality and establishing brand authority in Uttarakhand.

Target Audience:
High-intent patrons, local youth, lifestyle connoisseurs, and regional event attendees across Dehradun and northern India.

Execution Phases:
- Phase 1: Pre-Production & Drone Flight Mapping: Site survey, lighting check, flight path clearance for aerial reveal shots, and synchronized event shot list.
- Phase 2: Multi-Crew Live Production: 2 camera operators covering dynamic candid and VIP moments, 1 high-resolution still photographer, and 1 licensed drone pilot for sweeping 4K aerials.
- Phase 3: Post-Production & Delivery: Turnaround of 2 viral launch reels with sound design and kinetic titles, 1 cinematic 4K brand launch showcase film, and complete uncompressed raw footage archive.

items.details: On-site cinematic shoot coverage by 2 professional camera operators equipped with Sony FX/A7 cinema bodies, prime lenses, and gimbal stabilization.
Licensed 4K aerial drone cinematography capturing sweeping reveal shots, architectural perspectives, and dynamic spatial coverage of the launch.
Dedicated on-site photographer capturing high-resolution candid moments, VIP arrivals, atmosphere, and color-graded event stills.

items.desc: Post-Production & Edited Content (2 Reels, 1 Cinematic Video & Raw Content)
items.details: Complete post-production suite including 2 high-retention launch reels, 1 cinematic brand showcase video, sound design, color grading, and delivery of 100% raw content.
